groupings.title: Requirements Engineering
groupings.description: INCOSE-based end-to-end workflow to elicit, formalize, and validate software requirements. Tech-stack agnostic — works for backend, frontend, mobile, infra, and embedded. The four skills are orchestrated by interview-requirements and must be installed together for the workflow to function.

groupings.title: Refactor Safety
groupings.description: Complementary skill for safely refactoring legacy code that lacks test coverage. Tech-stack agnostic (Laravel, .NET, Java, Python, Node, COBOL). Not part of the requirements orchestrator — invoke manually when needed.
